name: Refund Policy
response: Our refund policy allows returns within 30 days of purchase. I can process a refund up to $100 automatically. For larger amounts, I'll need to escalate to a supervisor.

name: Password Reset
response: I can help you reset your password. I'll send a secure reset link to your registered email address.

name: Order Tracking
response: I can look up your order status. Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days, and express shipping takes 1-2 business days.

name: Subscription Cancellation
response: Subscription cancellations require manager approval for security purposes. I'll create an escalation ticket for you.

name: Technical Support
response: I'm sorry you're experiencing technical difficulties. Let me create a support ticket for our engineering team.

name: Billing Inquiry
response: I can help you review your billing details and recent charges. Let me pull up your account information.

name: Goodwill Credit
response: I can apply a goodwill credit to your account (up to $50) as a gesture of appreciation for your patience.

name: Human Agent Escalation
response: I understand you'd like to speak with a human agent. Let me connect you right away.
